title: Barber's symptoms compared with John Burroughs' from Rendlesham
summary: Jake Barber tells of Barber's symptoms compared with John Burroughs' from Rendlesham, about 1980 to present at Rendlesham Forest, Suffolk, UK, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: John Burroughs and Jim Penniston. John Burrows had had similar symptoms that I did and had similar issues with his VA records as I did.

plain: Jake Barber, a former helicopter pilot who says he retrieved a UFO, tells podcast host Jesse Michels he learned, through a scientist named Garry Nolan, about John Burroughs and Jim Penniston, two US airmen who reported a strange craft in Rendlesham Forest in England in 1980. Barber says Burroughs had health symptoms similar to his own and similar trouble with his records at the VA, the US agency that handles veterans' health care. If true, it would point to a shared pattern of harm from such encounters, and of paperwork going wrong afterward.
